cases.exposure_context_quote: A 28-year-old Bangladeshi male deliberately ingested one aluminum phosphide (ALP) tablet (approximately 3 g), which was fresh and dissolved in water prior to ingestion.
cases.agent: aluminum phosphide (single tablet, approximately 3 g, fresh, dissolved in water)
cases.agent_quote: deliberately ingested one aluminum phosphide (ALP) tablet (approximately 3 g), which was fresh and dissolved in water prior to ingestion
cases.circumstance: suicide attempt; history of major depressive disorder with irregular psychiatric follow-up

symptoms.finding: nausea, recurrent vomiting, abdominal pain, dizziness
symptoms.quote: The patient initially had nausea, recurrent vomiting, abdominal pain, and dizziness.
Physical examination revealed a tachycardia with 104 beats per minute, BP 85/60 mmHg, oxygen saturation was 95 percent on room air, and the respiratory rate was 22 breaths per minute.

symptoms.finding: atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular rate on ECG
symptoms.quote: Electrocardiogram (ECG) showed atrial fibrillation with a rapid ventricular rate.
Blood gas analysis (intended arterial sampling) showed metabolic acidosis (pH 7.36, HCO₃⁻ 11.7 mmol/L, pCO2 21 mmHg, pO2 44 mmHg).

cases.time_to_care: presented to tertiary care facility approximately 7 hours after ingestion; gastric lavage at local hospital before transfer

labs.name: pH (day 1)
labs.quote: Blood gas analysis (intended arterial sampling) showed metabolic acidosis (pH 7.36, HCO₃⁻ 11.7 mmol/L, pCO2 21 mmHg, pO2 44 mmHg).

labs.name: HCO3- (day 1)
labs.quote: worsening acidosis (pH 7.29, HCO3− 11.1 mmol/L on day two)

treatment.name: gastric lavage (at local hospital)
treatment.quote: He was initially examined in a local hospital where he underwent gastric lavage prior to being transferred to our tertiary care facility.

treatment.name: aggressive IV fluid resuscitation (normal saline and Hartmann solution)
treatment.quote: The patient was put on aggressive intravenous fluid resuscitation using normal saline and Hartmann solution

treatment.name: titrated noradrenaline infusion (0.05 then up to 0.5 µg/kg/min)
treatment.quote: titrated infusion of noradrenaline (initiated at 0.05 µg/kg/minutes) to sustain a mean arterial pressure of more than 65 mmHg

treatment.name: intravenous hydrocortisone
treatment.quote: Intravenous hydrocortisone was administered in the setting of persistent hypotension despite adequate fluid resuscitation and vasopressor support, as part of management of refractory shock.

treatment.name: oral N-acetylcysteine via nasogastric tube
treatment.quote: Oral N-acetylcysteine was administered via a nasogastric tube as an adjunctive measure, as intravenous formulation was not available in our setting.

treatment.name: sodium bicarbonate
treatment.quote: Sodium bicarbonate was administered to treat severe metabolic acidosis.

treatment.name: bisoprolol (low-dose beta-blocker) for rate control
treatment.quote: rate control was initiated with a low-dose beta-blocker (bisoprolol), with careful monitoring for hemodynamic stability.

treatment.name: antiemetics and proton pump inhibitors
treatment.quote: Prior to administration, antiemetics and proton pump inhibitors were given to improve tolerability.

cases.outcome: survived; discharged day 6 with psychiatric follow-up; complete recovery at 3-week follow-up
cases.outcome_quote: Psychiatric referral was made to optimize the management of underlying depressive disorder and he was discharged on oral therapy of proton pump inhibitor, antiemetic and antidepressant.
cases.notes: Atrial fibrillation reverted to sinus rhythm by day 4; ABG normalized day 3. Discharged on oral PPI, antiemetic, antidepressant.
